old_proof.text: The target category of sheaves of modules has zero morphisms. Mathlib supplies zero morphisms in the functor category, with zero natural transformation having zero at every object; naturality follows from composition with zero. Thus the zero natural transformation is a witness to Nonempty. This proves the stated bare existence, without claiming normalization or compatibility with the derived unit.
